mapper.select: SELECT b.bidx, b.coverImg, b.title, b.subtitle, b.author, b.publisher, b.publishedYear, b.totalPages, COUNT(l.lidx) AS loanCount FROM BOOKS b JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS lb ON b.bidx = lb.bidx JOIN LOAN l ON lb.lbidx = l.lbidx WHERE MONTH(l.loanDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(l.loanDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY b.bidx ORDER BY loanCount DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT b.bidx, b.coverImg, b.title, b.subtitle, b.author, b.publisher, b.publishedYear, b.totalPages FROM BOOKS b ORDER BY b.publishedYear DESC LIMIT 6
